official_name.value: The American University of the Emirates

min_standing_note.value: Enrolled home-institution students must hold an official No-Objection Letter from their home university and good academic standing to study as Visiting Students (up to two semesters).

eligible_majors.notes: Exact University-wide agreement scope across AUE's seven colleges (Business, Media & Mass Comm, Security & Global Studies, CIT, Design, Law, Education per DOCX).

excluded_majors.notes: No excluded major list published in AUE DOCX or aue.ae/visiting/.

min_gpa_host.notes: Good academic standing verified via home-university transcript/No-Objection Letter; no numeric GPA threshold published on aue.ae/visiting/.

instruction_languages.notes: Instruction at AUE uses English (except specific Arabic/law tracks if applicable).

english_course_availability.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/AUEmirates/The American University of the Emirates.docx
english_course_availability.notes: Seven colleges offer UG/GR programs largely in English.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Undergraduate visiting/admission requirement: Academic IELTS >=5.0, TOEFL iBT >=61, or TOEFL ITP >=500 (Graduate level: IELTS 6.0/6.5 or TOEFL iBT >=79); conditional ELI/IEP tracks exist.

fall_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Fall Semester (Weekdays): Classes Aug 30 - Dec 20, 2026 (Add/Drop Aug 31 - Sep 6; Midterms Oct 19-25; Final Exams Dec 14-20; Winter Break Dec 21 - Jan 1).

spring_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Spring Semester (Weekdays): Classes Jan 3 - May 7, 2027 (Add/Drop Jan 4-10; Midterms Feb 22-28; Spring Break Apr 5-11; Final Exams May 1-7, 2027).

tuition_model.notes: No bilateral exchange tuition-waiver clause verified publicly on aue.ae (aue.ae lists standard UG ~AED 45,600/yr and GR ~AED 72,000/yr COA without an exchange waiver page).

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Derived monthly living range from AUE Cost of Attendance annual figures divided by 12 months: Accommodation AED 15,000-30,000 + Cost of living AED 36,000 + Transportation AED 6,000 + Utilities AED 12,000 = AED 69,000-84,000/yr -> AED 5,750-7,000/month. (Outdated 2020-21 local DOCX estimated 12,500 USD/yr or $1,214-1,938 USD/mo).

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month estimate derived from monthly AED range 5,750-7,000 (midpoint 6,375.0)/month. Official peg 1 USD = 3.6725 AED (1 AED = 0.272294 USD) from Central Bank of the UAE (retrieved 2026-11-15 at https://centralbank.ae/en/reports-and-statistics/exchange-rates/); 5-month USD est = 6,375.0 AED * 5 / 3.6725 = 8,679.37 USD.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: AUE Cost of Attendance lists mandatory annual fees (Internet & Lab AED 1,050, Health Care Services AED 252, Admission AED 3,150 UG/3,675 GR; Books AED 1,575) plus University Health Insurance AED 1,000 and UAE student visa fees if sponsored by AUE.

housing_availability.notes: External student residences in Dubai International Academic City (e.g., KSK Homes / Yugo Homes) recommended by AUE (AED 15,000-30,000/yr).

housing_notes.value: KSK Homes / Yugo Homes options in Dubai International Academic City estimated at AED 15,000-30,000/yr per AUE Cost of Attendance.

host_grants_or_stipends.notes: No incoming visiting/exchange stipend published on aue.ae.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Non-UAE students requiring an AUE-sponsored UAE Student Visa must enroll in >=3 courses (9 credit hours) and budget visa fees (AED 3,675 outside UAE / AED 4,200 inside UAE), refundable passport deposit AED 5,500, medical test AED 420, Emirates ID AED 189, and health insurance AED 1,000.

english_course_list_url.notes: Programs and courses listed inside AUE catalogs at https://aue.ae/catalogs-handbooks/; no separate exchange English filter URL.

credit_system_and_load.value: US credit-hour system (minimum 3 courses / 9 credit hours required for AUE student visa sponsorship).

course_restrictions_note.value: Visiting students enroll in specific pre-approved courses for up to 2 semesters with home-institution No-Objection Letter; visa holders must take >=9 credits.

value: Official No-Objection Letter from home institution
Passport & UAE visa documents (if sponsored by AUE)

academic_style.notes: American-style semester weekday calendar (with weekend/evening sections noted separately); pedagogical details not detailed in verified excerpts.

city_tier.notes: Located in Dubai (Dubai International Academic City, Block 6 & 7); Dubai population threshold not cited on aue.ae.

campus_type.notes: Located inside Dubai International Academic City campus zone (DOCX); aue.ae does not classify campus_type using schema enum labels.

international_support_services.value: Student Life, UAE Student Visa sponsorship processing, DIAC partner housing referrals (KSK/Yugo Homes), and Campus Health Care Services.

nomination_deadlines.notes: AUE admits Fall, Spring, and Summer cohorts via visiting student process (https://aue.ae/visiting/); exact bilateral partner nomination/application cutoffs not published publicly.
